title: Quality Studio performance
summary: Tracks measured startup, repository switching, tree transport, review-run latency, rendering, and long-session memory. QS-82 implements the lazy tree transport slice and integrates QS-78 snapshot restoration without duplicating QS-54 cache work; re-measured on 2026-08-24, independently reproduced on the committed tree b36bfe3, and re-verified on 2026-08-27 against origin/main f7557fb.
